headline: Abbott Laboratories vs. Johnson & Johnson: Which Healthcare Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?

headline: Guardant Health, Thursday's Stock Of The Day, Spikes After Hiking 2026 Outlook
summary: Guardant Health is Thursday's IBD Stock Of The Day in a thriving market for colon cancer screening tests.  On Friday, Guardant Health stock surged after the company raised full-year outlook after a Q2 revenue beat late Thursday.  Several analysts raised price targets on GH stock after the Q2 report, by as much as $50 a share, according to TheFly.com.

headline: AbbVie’s (NYSE:ABBV) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
summary: Pharmaceutical company AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.2% year on year to $16.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.65 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
